name: eierman
tagline: IT, e-scooter tuning and small tools that scratch my own itch.
intro: Hi, I'm Felix. I work in IT and tune e-scooters past their limits. Whatever bugs me along the way turns into a small tool.

facts.label: Scooters
facts.text: Modding them and making them faster than intended. Only SHU so far, VESC is next.

facts.label: Games
facts.text: Fortnite right now, Valorant for shooters, Minecraft SMPs with friends, and Roblox on my second channel.

facts.label: Homelab
facts.text: A NAS at home running Jellyfin, Immich and a few smaller things in Docker.

facts.label: Anime
facts.text: Romance, drama and slice of life. If it makes me cry, it's good.
